service: synthetic Redmine REST via httpx.MockTransport, SQLite committed journals
model: ScriptedChatModel only in session cases; zero provider requests
order: paired by index; even indices baseline first, odd indices reconcile first
isolation: independent fixture database and file-backed production SqliteStore per logical operation and strategy; same input/contract/loss index across each pair

main_schedule.action: submit once; selected first PUT commits then raises httpx.ReadTimeout
reopen client and SqliteStore; baseline resends unacknowledged input once; production reconcile_operations(readonly, include_completed=True)

baseline.retry_wait: one logical tick, no wall-clock sleep
baseline.authorization: same production scope/principal check, note grant, note validation, ticket project/status/assignee checks; initial expected_version guard
baseline.retransmission: replay the already admitted raw request after refreshing authorization and current ticket; original version is a first-admission precondition; journal evidence does not suppress a replay
baseline.acknowledgement: successful HTTP response persisted; acknowledgement carries no verified journal ID
baseline.exhaustion: missing acknowledgement after two sends remains unknown

reconcile.recovery: unmodified read-only reconciliation; completed records included
reconcile.receipt: production Receipt verified against journal body, author, ID and marker

schedule.action: persist deferred first PUT; timeout before commit
new process; baseline resends once, production read-only session recovery remains uncertain
commit original deferred request in synthetic server
new process; production read-only session recovery, baseline reopens acknowledged task
commit first PUT and receive success; exit process with code 86 after production operation receipt is stored but before session tool Command checkpoint, or before baseline acknowledgement checkpoint
new process; production execute_session(resume=True) calls read-only reconciliation; baseline resends missing acknowledgement once

schedule: process 1 persists two native queued write tools using interrupt_before=['tools']
parent holds production session_storage lock; process 2 revoke returns session_busy with zero HTTP
release lock; process 3 successfully commits revoke_session_writes
record successful revoke return as conservative committed boundary
process 4 rejects stale writable contract, reloads readonly contract, resumes with two scripted write probes and read-only reconciliation
revocation.primary_metric: HTTP write admissions after successful revoke return
revocation.interpretation: specified queued-tool schedule and process lock semantics; preemption of already executing writes is outside this schedule

metrics.denominator: logical operations within strategy and normal/fault-hit cohort; all planned attempts retained including failures; deterministic cases and revocation counted separately
metrics.fault_rate: 50/100 first logical-operation responses selected to be lost after commit in each main strategy; retry responses are delivered
metrics.business_complete: at least one exact intended journal, unchanged initial ticket status/assignee/project
metrics.exactly_once: business_complete and exactly one intended journal
metrics.unknown: client durable pending intent or missing baseline acknowledgement after a send, sampled at registered phase boundaries
metrics.unknown_duration: sum of logical tick intervals with unknown state; simulated schedule units, wall-clock MTTR is not measured
metrics.receipts: persisted raw HTTP acknowledgements and production verified receipts reported separately; observer uniqueness reported identically for both strategies
metrics.raw: request/response/commit/fault events with phase, logical tick, PID, exact bodies; server before/after, Store snapshots, session checkpoints/traces, child exit/stdout/stderr
metrics.scope: fixed synthetic note operations and deterministic schedules; descriptive mechanism comparison, separate from real Redmine production reliability

acceptance.main: all 200 planned slots retained; loss sequence matched; exactly 50 commit-then-loss hits per strategy; raw-derived counts reconcile
acceptance.production: business completion and exactly-once checked independently, final unknown preserved on failure
acceptance.deterministic: new process recovery plus retained checkpoint/Store evidence; all unexpected errors retained and cause nonzero runner exit
acceptance.revocation: session_busy while locked; two queued calls cancelled; stale contract rejected; two fresh probes write_not_authorized; zero post-revoke HTTP writes
acceptance.tuning: fixed schedule and metric definitions before execution; all run directories retained
